audit.title: Recent Login Activities (Audit Logs)
audit.empty: No records yet or Reports API permission incomplete.
audit.delayNote: NOTE: Reports API data may be delayed up to 24 hours.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Reports page gives you an audit and status summary of your organization; user metrics, recent login activities and suspended accounts are gathered into a single screen.

sections.heading: Metrics
paragraphs: The cards at the top of the page show the total, active and suspended user counts.

sections.heading: Recent Login Activities
paragraphs: Recent sign-in records (date, user, IP address) are listed via the Reports API.

callout.text: Reports API data on Google's side can be delayed by up to 24 hours; it is normal for the list to be empty or incomplete.

sections.heading: Suspended Users & Refresh
paragraphs: Users that are currently suspended are listed in a separate section. Use the "Refresh Data" button to re-fetch all reports with the latest data.
